question: Should OpenClaw accept this restart-specific durable audit table, redacted metadata boundary, fixed 512-row retention, and restart-path SQLite writes as the product/security contract?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but automation should not decide the permanent local audit/privacy boundary or durable storage model for operators.

options.title: Accept restart audit storage
options.body: Merge after a clean rebase once maintainers accept the table, metadata fields, redaction, retention, and write placement.

options.title: Narrow persisted metadata first
options.body: Require a smaller field set or stricter redaction/privacy contract before merging the durable storage path.

options.title: Wait for broader audit ledger
options.body: Pause this restart-specific table if the broader audit-ledger direction should own the canonical schema first.

recommendation.title: Accept restart audit storage
recommendation.body: Merge after a clean rebase once maintainers accept the table, metadata fields, redaction, retention, and write placement.

likelyOwner.reason: History points to steipete as the strongest owner for the restart, gateway reload, and shared state DB surfaces involved in the product/security boundary.
